task.role: Orchestrate only the V2 forensic audit. Do not perform global research or solution architecture.
task.resource_rule: Do not load all GitHub resources into orchestrator context. Spawn clean workers and give each only assigned repo paths from RESOURCE_INDEX.json.

workers.group: Spawn ten workers QA-R01..QA-R10. Each receives only `knowledge/retailers/{RID}.json`, which contains its retailer card, sources, evidence and repairs. Verify URLs, dates, quotes, source tiers, numbers and status. Save full verdicts as separate files.

Spawn QA-MARKET for `knowledge/market_context.json`; QA-CORPUS for `knowledge/corpus.json` plus `reports/corpus_index.md`; QA-PATTERNS for `knowledge/analysis.json`, `knowledge/manifests.json`, Solution Pattern Atlas and final report.
Spawn QA-J only after workers finish. Give QA-J concise issue manifests and resource pointers, not all raw records. QA-J creates accepted V2 base and preserves rejected/unresolved IDs.

mandatory_checks.check: Pattern economics without evidence ID arrays.
Corpus registry vs narrative URL/title mismatches.

task.outputs: Full files: A_audit_verdicts.jsonl, A_accepted_v2_base.jsonl, A_rejected_unresolved.jsonl, A_forensic_report.md. Compact file: A_HANDOFF.json per schema, maximum 90 KB.
task.final_chat: Return run IDs, counts, files, A_HANDOFF byte size and stop. Do not continue in this Task.
